rationale: C03 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both letters begin by describing a sustained concern about the nation's scientific capacity, explain why existing governmental arrangements are insufficient, establish a science-focused advisory committee, appoint the recipient as chairman, enumerate the committee's functions, contemplate cooperation with private scientific groups, and request continuing advice or progress reports. C20 and C01 share committee-appointment machinery, but their operative structures and subject-specific language are less closely aligned with the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: For the last several years there has been a growing awareness... [of] our continuing shortages of highly qualified scientists and engineers... Because of my own concern with this situation...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: For some time, I have been considering the best means whereby scientists of the country could be assisted and encouraged... At the same time, I have been increasingly mindful of the many demands which the Federal programs are placing upon scientific resources...
shared_material.explanation: Both open with a sustained presidential concern about inadequate scientific resources and the Government's dependence on scientific capacity.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am establishing the National Committee which has been proposed. It is my hope that the Committee will: 1. Assist the Federal Government... 2. Enlist the cooperation... 3. Make available... information... 4. Publicize the problem... 5. Provide me... with a report of progress.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have therefore determined to establish a Science Advisory Committee... a. To provide independent advice... b. To advise on progress... c. To advise concerning plans and methods... d. For transmitting the views of the scientific community...
shared_material.explanation: The central operative machinery is closely parallel: establishment of a science committee followed immediately by an enumerated mandate linking scientific experts or organizations to federal policy.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It gives me a great deal of satisfaction to appoint you Chairman of this Committee.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am therefore appointing you as Chairman...
shared_material.explanation: The chairmanship appointment uses nearly identical language in the same structural setting.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Enlist the cooperation of all interested individuals and groups... [and] provide me, from time to time, with a report of progress.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I expect that you will freely call on private scientific groups and individuals for assistance. I shall welcome the recommendations of the Committee and shall call upon it for advice from time to time.
shared_material.explanation: Both direct the committee to engage nongovernmental scientific participants and maintain an ongoing advisory relationship with the President.
